'''2000 Tierfon Con I''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament held in the Tierfon region (Belgium) in late 2000. [[Olivier De Ridder]] won it, beating Fabien Jacques, Milan Angeli and Bastiaan Proot along the way.<ref name="dt-11611">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11611 Winner light of Tierfon Con I], DeckTech (Olivier "Bel Iblis" De Ridder, 8 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11611/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11611/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018095501/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11611/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 4 November 2000<ref name="tr-d1423" />
* '''Site:''' Belgium (Tierfon region); De Striep, Bruges, Belgium<ref name="tr-d1423" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 25<ref name="tr-d1423" />
